༄༅/ /gsang spyod rdo rje lam bstan bzhugs so/ /rin chen shog skya'i skor/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsang spyod rdo rje lam bstan bzhugs so/ /

rin chen shog skya'i skor/ gsang spyod rdo rje lam bstan zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin byas pa med pa'i ngang nyid las/ /skye med lhun rdzogs snying po'i gdangs shar ba/ /mtha' grol klong yangs rang bzhin rdzogs pa che/ / rang shar rang sar grol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig zab mo'i gnad bsdus nas/ /don zab 'gag 'dril nyams su blang bde ba/ /gang dang mi 'dra kun gyis ma rtogs pa/ /ji ltar bdag gis rtogs bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /bde chen gnas 'di stong gsal 'dus ma byas/ /snying dbus gzhon nu bum pa'i skur gsal ba/ /ye shes nyid de nang gsal lhun gyis grub/ /'od lnga'i gdangs las snod bcud snang srid chags/ /snang bas stong ste chu zla'i gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /lhun grub goms pas nam zhig 'od lngar grol/ /de yang rang gnas ka dag rang grol nas/ /mtha' bzhi las 'das sprin med nam mkha' 'dra/ /e ma'o bzhin dang me long gzugs brnyan bzh-in/ /bdag gzhan gnyis snang rang gis btags par zad/ /rang bzhin gnyis med gdod nas stong pa'i ngang*/ /dgra gnyen dgag sgrub gang yang ma mthong ngo*/ /mi mkhas byis pa dag gis gnyis bzung ste/ /lha dang 'dre zhes goms pas de ltar snang*/ /'dod 'jigs mya ngan goms pas der snang bzhin/ /med snang 'khrul pas 'gro ba 'di bslus so/ /gang la phyi rol cir snang rang gi sems/ /snang la gnyis med 'od gsal gdod ma'i ngang*/ /phyi rol ma yin nang gi gzugs brnyan tsam/ /thams cad sku lnga ye shes dag pa'i gdangs/ /lha dang 'drer snang bde chen mkha' 'gro'i zhing*/ /rang snang nyid de dngos grub 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /dgag sgrub phan gnod sems kyi rtsal sbyong yin/ /de la dga' bas mchod sbyin brtsam par rigs/ /kye ho bde sdug rkyen rnams rmi lam 'dra/ /rang snang gnyis 'dzin gzugs brnyan shar ba la/ /rang ngo ma shes da dung 'khor bar snang*/ /ye stong rtsa bral gdod ma'i ngang 'di la/

/snang stong gnyis med kun brtags cho 'phrul tsam/ /snod bcud snang srid lha dang lha mo'i zhing*/ /gang snang gzugs rnams 'od gsal lha yi sku/ /sgra rnams grags stong sngags kyi dkyil 'khor te/ /rtog pa'i 'phro 'du ye shes rol pa che/ /snang grags snod bcud gnyis med chos sku'i ngang*/ /stong la dngos snang rang bzhin gzugs kyi sku/ /gdod nas stong ngo rtsa bral gnyug ma'i ngang*/ /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i rol pa ni/ /skye med lhun rdzogs rang bzhin rdzogs pa che/ /ye grol gdod nas dag pa'i chos nyid la/ /blang dang dor med dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med/ /ye stong babs stong rang bzhin gdod nas stong*/ /'di zhes mi mtshon tshig gis shes mi nus/ /rten med gzhi grol yongs rdzogs ka dag dang*/ /gang snang gsal stong rang bzhin chu zla 'dra/ /sna tshogs mi gnyis rnam kun stong pa'i gzugs/ / kun bzang gzhi yi dgongs klong yangs pa ni/ /mi 'gyur lta ba'i khyung chen rtogs pa yin/ /mdor na snang grags snang srid chos rnams kun/ /ngo bo stong la rang bzhin gzugs brnyan tsam/ /thugs rje ma 'gags cir yang shar ba la/ /'di zhes ma ི 'dzin mtha' grol klong yangs so/ /ji ltar snang ba de ltar stong pa ste/ /chu dang chu zla gnyis su mi phyed bzhin/ /gnyis med don zhes brda tsam btags pa tsam/ /snang rung stong rung rtag rung mi rtag rung*/ /gang shar btags pa de ltar shar ba tsam/ /shar nub rnyog bral stong gsal phyam phyam mo/ /'di ltar rtogs nas gnyis 'dzin rang grol te/ /'dzin med phyam gdal ye grol sor gzhag go /ngang nyid ma skyes kun tu bzang po'i zhing*/ / rtogs pa'i lta ba yangs na mngon du 'gyur/ /pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis bstan nas song*/ /gsang spyod rdo rje lam bstan las/ /lta ba rdo rje'i le'u ste dang po'o// // de nas sgom pa 'od gsal chen po ni/ /lta ba'i don la goms par byed pa ste/

/nyin dus 'od gsal nam mkha'i mthongs su blta/ /sems kyis mi bsam sgom pa bsgom pa min/ /rang bzhin gnyis med chu zla gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /'di zhes mi mtshon gzung 'dzin kun las 'das/ /gdod ma'i ka dag lhun grub mngon du 'gyur/ /des ni 'khrul snang longs skur 'char ba yin/ /mtshan dus bde ba'i mal du bag phab ste/ /rang babs lhod chags gnyid du log pa'i tshe/ /nyin snang 'gags pas tshe 'di 'dor ba dang*/ / gnyid du 'gro bas 'byung bzhi thim tshul dang*/ /ma rig gnyid kyis gzhi yi 'od gsal dang*/ /rmi lam sna tshogs bar do'i 'char tshul dang*/ /gnyid sad snang bas rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing*/ /bgrod nas gang snang rang bzhin dag pa'i zhing*/ /sems can lha dang lha mor dran par bya/ /tha mal dran bsam rang rgyud 'dzin pa dor/ /gnyid dang rmi lam gnyid sad snang ba gsum/ /chos sku longs sku sprul skur rtogs byas la/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong zung 'brel rnam gsum gyis/ /bde gsal mi rtog blo 'das chen por nyal/ /de yis gnyid dang rmi lam rgyun chad de/ /gdod ma'i ka dag 'od gsal ngang du gnas/ / 'di ltar gnyid la nyal lugs rnam pa gsum/ /bde ba'i mal du 'dzin med phyam gdal ba/ /'od gsal chos sku'i ngang du nyal ba yis/ /rmi lam rgyun chad 'khrul pa gzhi thog thim/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin spros dang bral ba yin/ / de bzhin nang 'od bum pa'i sbubs nyid du/ /ye shes 'od lnga 'dzin med nyal ba yis/ /rmi lam 'od gsal longs sku'i ngang du thim/ /sku dang thig le 'od lnga'i snang ba 'char/ /dag pa'i zhing snang rigs lnga'i snang bar mthong*/ /snang ba'i rang bzhin spros dang bral ba yin/ /de bzhin rang lus sprul pa'i 'jig rten na/ /ston pa'i zhabs drung yid kyis rab dmigs te/ /rigs lnga'i sa bon nyid la sems bsdus nyal/ /rmi lam bar snang sprul pa'i skur thim nas/ /mngon dga' la sogs zhing snang sna tshogs 'char/

/phyi dus dag pa'i zhing der grol bar nges/ /sna tshogs gnyis med dag pa'i sprul sku yin/ / gnyid dang rmi lam sad dus rnam pa gsum/ /gdod nas sku gsum nyid du gnas pa'i tshul/ /ji bzhin gzugs brnyan gnyis pa'i rnam pa la/ /lam du goms pas 'bras bu sku gsum grol/ /de yang goms pa'i gnad ni 'di bzhin sbyang*/ /gnyid sad dus na yul rnams sprul sku'i zhing*/ /mngon dga' la sogs gsal btab ldang bar bya/ /dus gsum dus rnams kun tu sku gsum zhing*/ /'od gsal sku gsum rdzogs pa'i nyams len bya/ /yul sems gnyis med rang snang shes par bya/ /bzhin dang me long lta bu'i lam khyer gyis/ /nyon mongs chags sdang rang snang rang grol zhing*/ /rang shar ye grol nam mkha'i mdud pa ltar/ /rang gi blo yis byas shing bshig pa ltar/ / gang snang rkyen rnams de ltar shes pas sbyang*/ /'di ltar spyod lam dus rnams thams cad du/ /rang snang 'og min rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas zhing*/ /phyi nang gsang gsum sgrub pa'i lam khyer bya/ /de yis lhun grub kun tu bzang po'i zhing*/ /brtson 'grus rab kyis tshe 'dir 'grub pa ste/ /'bring rnams bar dor 'od gsal gnyis med 'dres/ /tha mas rang bzhin sprul skur grol ba ni/ /goms pa'i gnad 'dis myur du 'grub pa yin/ /mdor na gnyid dus bar do'i gdams pa dran/ /ldang dus rang bzhin sprul sku'i rtsal sbyang bya/ / nyin dus 'od gsal phyi ru 'dzin pa'i tshe/ /snang sems gnyis med rang grol chen por sbyang*/ /mtshan dus 'od gsal nang du 'dzin pa'i tshe/ /sku gsum dbyer med gdod ma'i zad sar bskyal/ /ldang dus rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing snang la/ /sgyu ma rmi lam 'od gsal chen por sbyang*/ /chags sdang la sogs nyon mongs gang shar yang*/ /'dzin med rang grol gza' gtad bral bar sbyang*/ /rkyen rnams sems kyi rtsal sbyong me long ste/ /ji ltar snang ba de ltar 'dzin med sbyang*/

/'di ltar phyi nang snang srid chos rnams la/ /sgom par ma gyur rdul tsam yod min pas/ /snang sems gang shar rang grol rtsal sbyang bya/ /'di ni yang zab snying po'i sgom pa ste/ /bying rgod gnyid med zhi lhag zung du 'brel/ /snang stong thabs shes ye nas zung 'jug yin/ /blang dor re dogs dgag sgrub 'das pa'i don/ /pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis bstan nas song*/ /gsang spyod rdo rje lam bstan las/ /sgom pa rdo rje'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// // de ltar lta sgom bogs 'byin spyod pa ste/ /deng dang ma 'phel 'gribs dang rkyen thog dbab/ /bde sdug sdug bsngal na tsha ci byung na'ang*/ /dur khrod la sogs dben pa'i gnas song ste/ /dam gtsang ngo tsha tshul 'chos rab spangs la/ /gnyis med rang grol lta sgom ngang nyid dang*/ /blang dor 'dzin med smyon pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /'gro dang 'dug dang mchongs dang rgyug pa dang*/ /smra dang dgod dang ngu dang glu len dang*/ /dga' dang mi dga' chags sdang bde sdug dang*/ /rigs drug spyod pa mthong thos dran tshad bya/ /rjes la gang shar rang grol rtsal sbyong gis/ /lta sgom don de thog tu phebs sam blta/ /ji srid gnyis 'dzin dgag sgrub ma zhig par/ /brtul zhugs spyod pas brtson pas spyod par bya/ /mtshan dus rang babs bde bar nyal nas kyang*/ /dran bsam 'phro 'du'i rnam rtog kun bral te/ /skye med lhun rdzogs gnyug ma'i ngang du nyal/ /des ni bdag gzhan dgag sgrub re dogs med/ /dgra gnyen gnyis med gser dang bong ba mnyam/ /rkyen ngan lam bslangs snang ba grogs su 'char/ /lta sgom bogs 'byin rtogs pa nam mkha' 'dra/ /sgom pa rang gsal spyod pa bu chung 'dra/ /gza' gtad kun bral ngang gis smyon pa 'dra/ /ye grol phyam gdal rang babs rgan po 'dra/ /gzeg dang snyems bral dur khrod mi ro 'dra/ /'dzin med rang grol yul med skye bo 'dra/ /bdag gzhan gnyis med 'phags pa'i gang zag

'dra/ /nyon mongs rang grol chu dang rba rlabs 'dra/ /ci smras don med brag cha'i sgra dbyangs 'dra/ /gang la'ang chags med 'dab chags mkha' lding 'dra/ /spang gnyen rang grol sbrul gyi mdud pa 'dra/ /thams cad ye grol mkha' la sprin dengs 'dra/ /de 'dra'i skal bzang bde gshegs rig 'dzin dngos/ /dad brgya'i spyi bos btud nas phyag bya'i 'os/ /yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang ches lhag pa'i/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi/ khyad par nad gdon chos 'phrul ci byung yang*/ /nags dang dur khrod mtsho gling skyed mos tshal/ /phug dang khong stong shing gcig drung la sogs/ /'jigs shing nyams nga dben pa'i sa phyogs der/ /bcag dang dkrugs long smyon pa'i spyod pa dang*/ /zhib dang nges pa 'jam pos rnam pas nyal/ /snang sems ro gcig sems su thag bcad la/ /sems nyid ma bcos chos sku'i ngang du nyal/ /de yang sngon 'gro byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /snying dbus 'od gsal 'od zer rab 'phros pas/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rig 'dzin mkha' 'gror bcas/ /snang srid lha 'dre gnod byed spyan drangs la/ /dbus su bla ma rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dang*/ /g.yas su yi dam g.yon du chos skyong dang*/ /rgyab tu gnod byed mdun du lan chags mgron/ /dus gsum pha ma rigs drug sems can bsam/ /yid kyis phyag 'tshal sna tshogs mchod pa dang*/ khyad par rang gi thod pa'i nang nyid du/ /lus 'di bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyur pa las/ /yaṃ las lung g.yos raṃ las me 'bar bas/ /thod pa'i bdud rtsi 'dod yon lngar gyur nas/ /rang nyid bye ba phrag stong mang sprul la/ / nam mkha'i mtha' khyab 'gro la bdud rtsi brims/ /dgyes shing tshims pas tshogs gnyis rdzogs par bsam/ /de bzhin phung po dum brgya dum stong dor/ /gnod byed lan chags gang 'dod sbyin par btang*/ / rjes la mgron rnams mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang*/ /skye med bsam yul 'das pa'i dbyings la bzhag

/de ltar mchod bya mchod byed rang gi sems/ /sems ni ma skyes ngo bo ngos gzung med/ /thams cad gzhi rdzogs rang bzhin nam mkha' 'dra/ / bsam rdzogs gdod ma'i chos nyid chen por shes/ /dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa'i dgongs par phyin/ /gzhi grol ka dag ngang du la bzla 'o/ /de kun 'gro la gnyis med phan gdags phyir/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pas bsngo ba bya/ /'di ni sngon 'gro bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /bar chad kun sel dngos grub rgya chen 'byung*/ /dngos gzhi sems la 'di ltar brtag par bya/ /de ltar yid kyis sna tshogs cir sprul yang*/ /thams cad rang gi sems su gcig pa ltar/ /'khor 'das dgag sgrub blang dor re dogs dang*/ /snang srid bdag gzhan gnyis snang sna tshogs dang*/ /'drer snang 'drer 'dzin ma lus rang gi sems/ /rmi lam bzhin te mi snang 'khrul pa'i sems/ /sems ni rtsa bral ye stong chos kyi sku/ /gzhi rdzogs kun tu bzang po'i rang bzhin te/ /phyogs dang ris med mtha' grol klong yangs so/ /dba' rlabs g.yo ba ri 'dra rgya mtsho'i ngang*/ /sna tshogs dgag sgrub rang sems stong pa'i ngang*/ / 'drer snang 'drer 'dzin gnyis med rtsa bral dang*/ /thams cad phyam cig rang babs chen po'i ngang*/ /mi g.yo mi gnas spros dang bral ba ni/ /gdod ma'i ka dag ngang du gnas pa yin/ /de ltar shes pas snang srid chos skur grol/ / nad gad ོna 'drer snang cho 'phrul stong par zhi/ /nam mkha'i sprin rnams g.yo ba dengs pa bzhin/ /shes rab chen pos gnyug ma'i gnas lugs shes/ / chos nyid sa la rang bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /thabs kyi rim pas 'di ltar shes par bya/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems bsgom la/ /'khor ba'i lan chags byang bar mos pa bya/ /bskal par bzhugs zhes dga' bas bkur sti bya/ /de nas mchod sbyin don la gzhag pa'i phyir/ /gdon la gzugs su grub pa yod dam med/ /yon na rdul phran bshig kyang dngos por med/

/gzugs de gzugs med rang gdangs shar ba tsam/ /rang snang 'od gsal me long gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /rags pa'i gzugs med chu zla'i rnam pa 'dra/ /de yis su la phan gnod byar ci yod/ /rags par yod na dngos su 'khyer gsha' yang*/ /gzugs med 'dre la 'jigs skrag sems kyis brtags/ /snang yang ma skyes stong pa'i rang bzhin no/ /'on te 'dra yi sems kyis gnod snyam na/ /sems ni dngos med ye nas dag pa la/ /gnod bya gnod byed gnyis su grub pa med/ /'drer snang 'drer 'dzin rang yid 'dzin pa ste/ /nam mkha'i mdud pa bzhin du 'ching grol byed/ /rang snang snyems dang bral na gzhan med de/ /me long bsdus pas gzugs brnyan mi snang bzhin/ /mi snang 'khrul pas srid pa'i grong khyer na/ /bdag gzhan gnyis snang rmi lam ci 'dra'o/ /rang snang rang gis gzung 'dzin gnyis bzos pas/ /'khor ba nyid ces ma rigs 'khrul snang yang*/ /legs par brtags na gnyis med chos kyi sku/ /gdod nas gzhi rtsa bral ba'i chos nyid do/ /kye ho snang srid sgyu ma'i grong khyer na/ /don med bden par bzung bar byis pa 'khor/ /'dzin med rnal 'byor pa rnams rtogs pas grol/ /nam mkha'i ri mo smig rgyu'i mtshon pa ru/ /sna tshogs gzugs brnyan gsal bas 'khrul ba ltar/ /mi snang 'gro ba don med a thang chad/ /ha ha gdod nas stong pa'i rang bzhin la/ /glo bur 'khrul rtog rkyen gyis cir snang yang*/ /nam zhig rang bzhin shes pas grol bar nges/ /gza' gtad med pa'i cho 'phrul chos sku'i ngang*/ /ye nas rtsa ba bral bas blo re bde/ /re dogs gnyis 'dzin zhig pas bag re dro/ /'gro ba'i rang bzhin ye nas sangs rgyas pas/ /glo bur bag chags sbyong ba yang mi dka'/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin gang gis gang la sgrib/ /thams cad ma skyes gdod nas stongs pas na/ /sems dang sgrib pa ye stong rtsa ba bral/ /gang zhig gang gis 'gro ba 'khrul bar 'dod/

/smig rgyu'i zhags pas mo gsham bu bcings zhes/ /sdug bsngal mthong nas mya ngan byed par zad/ /ngas ni chos kun de 'drar rab mthong nas/ /'ching grol gnyis med ye grol sangs rgyas zhes/ /bdag dang 'gro ba kun la gcig par rtogs/ /he he thams cad rang grol gza' gtad med/ /'di zhes sgrub tu yod na dga' ba la/ /re dogs 'bad rtsol zhig pas rab tu dal/ /de yin ngas shes gang shar yin du chug /gnyis su ma 'dzin re dogs 'phrang las 'das/ /gnyis med ma yin chos nyid gzhan na med/ /thad ka'i shes pa rang gzo'i bsnyems bral te/ /don dam chos nyid ye shes gdod ma'i ngang*/ / rtogs sla blo bde ngo bo phyam phyam mo/ /ma bsgoms sgom med snying po'i don mthong yang*/ /kye ma bdag blo rtsol ba'i gzeb tu 'ching*/ /ji tsam 'bad pa de tsam 'khrul pa'i yid/ /'khor ba'i chos te gang gis grol ba med/ /kye ho ma bcos rang sar dag pa'i ngang*/ /de rang nyid de rang babs gnyug ma'i don/ /gang shar rtsis med gza' gtad bral bar zhog

/dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs klong mthar thug yin/ /de ltar gnod byed gzhi nas med pa ltar/ /gnod yul rang yang ye nas ma grub ste/ /gnod do snyam na lus sems gang la gnod/ /lus ni rdul phran tsam du'ang brtags na med/ / sems ni dngos med ngos gzung kun dang bral/ /de la gnod pa skyel ba'i yul 'dug gam/ /brtags pas med bzhin ma brtags dus na'ang med/ / gnyis 'dzin thag pas rang sems bcings par zad/ /'ching grol gnyis med nam mkha'i ri mo 'dra/ /de ltar rtogs na 'dre yang lha nyid de/ /rang sems dag pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam du mthong*/ /lha med 'dre med rang sems stong pa'i ngang*/ /bsal gzhag 'gro 'ong gnyis med chos nyid la/ / bsnyems bral blo yis 'khrul gzhi zad pa yin/ /de ltar rtogs na re dogs rtsa ba stor/ /dgag sgrub blang dor chos nyid ngang du grol/ /gnyis med ye shes mnyam pa'i ngang du grol/ /'di ltar snang srid ye nas 'od gsal zhing*/ /'drer snang 'drer 'dzin lha dang lha mo'i ngang*/ /sna tshogs dran rig rang grol chos kyi sku/ /rten med gzhi grol rtsa bral gnyug ma'i ngang*/ /sgyu ma ye shes gnyis med chu zla'i ngang*/ /rang bzhin nam mkha' 'dra bar shes byas nas/ /bsnyems bral gza' gtad bral ba'i rtsal sbyang bya/ /de ltar gdon rnams chos sku grol ba ltar/ /nad kyang rig pa'i rtsal sbyang chos sku ste/ / byams dang snying rje byang chub sems 'byangs nas/ /'gro ba'i nad rnams gcig bsdus bdag la thim/ /bdag gi nad med bde ba 'gro la sbyin/ / bdag gi nad kyis 'gro kun bde bar shog /bskal par bzod bya bsran thub go bgos la/ /lus dang sems gnyis gang na legs par rtogs/ / lus 'di sa rdo dur khrod ro dang 'dra/ /sems ni mkha' 'dra kha dog dbyibs med pas/ /de la brtags na na rgyu na mkhan med/ /na bar 'dzin pa rang gi rtog pa tsam/ /dran rtog dngos med bar snang bser bu 'dra/

/gnyis med don la na ba yod mi srid/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pas nad ces btags par zad/ /btags kyang 'dogs mkhan rang bzhin gdod nas stong*/ /na ba'i lus kyang rdul phran gzhig pa'i tshe/ /nam mkha' 'dra zhing stong gsal chos sku'i ngang*/ /na ba gnyis med rang bzhin rdzogs pa che/ /gnas lugs gsal 'debs me long chen po yin/ /spang blang mi bya lta sgom rtsal sbyong bya/ /de bzhin bde sdug rkyen rnams ci shar tshe/ /bdag dang yul gnyis legs par dpyad byas la/ /kun rdzob rgyu rkyen rten 'brel mi bslu bas/ /sngon byas las yin bdag gis bzod par bya/ /don dam yul sems gzhig cing dpyad pa yis/ /dgra gnyen rang sems nam mkha'i ngang du grol/ /dgag sgrub gnyis 'dzin stong pa'i ngang du grol/ /'di zhes ched 'dzin mnyam nyid chen por grol/ /'gro 'dug snang sems 'dzin med ngang du grol/ /nga bdag gzung 'dzin blo 'das chos skur grol/ /lta sgom spyod 'bras gdod ma'i ngang du grol/ /phyogs res re dogs gzhi rtsa med par grol/ /ye grol yongs grol shar grol 'dzin pa med/ /gang snang gang byung gang yin 'di yin med/ /de ltar rtogs te dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras/ /dngos 'dzin 'khrul pa'i grong khyer zhig pa yin/ /de tshe byar med rdzogs chen nam mkha' la/ /bya bral gnyis med ngang gis gnas pa'i tshe/ /bya dang mi bya 'bad rtsol zhig pa'i mi/ / bya ba'i gzhi med byed mkhan stong par gnas/ /nga nyid yin na de tshe dga' ba la/ /ha ha rang gis kun tu brtags par zad/ /dga' dang mi dga'i gzhi las ye nas grol/ /smon pa'i yul med smon lam 'debs mkhan med/ /ngang yin ye yin rang bzhin rdzogs pa che/ /pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis bstan nas song*/ /gsang spyod rdo rje lam bstan las/ /spyod pa rdo rje'i glu ste le'u gsum pa'o// // de ltar lta sgom spyod par goms pa yis/ /gnas skabs mthar thug 'bras bu rnam pa gnyis/

/gnas skabs gnyis med 'od gsal goms pa yis/ /phyi ru dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa yis/ /mngon sum gong 'phel tshad phebs zad sar phyin/ /rdos bcas gnyis zad 'od gsal zhing khams snang*/ /nang rtsa 'od song rlung sems nyon mongs stong*/ /phyi nang zang thal zas gos dgos pa med/ /gsang bar 'khrul snang gnyis 'dzin rgyun chad nas/ / gzungs dang ting 'dzin mngon shes thogs med cing*/ /'pho ba chen po'i gzhan don lhun gyis grub/ /'di ni gnas skabs rig pa'i yon tan yin/ / mthar thug snang sems gdod ma'i gzhi la thim/ /nam mkha' bzhin te gzhon nu bum pa'i sku/ /nang gsal sku gsum ye shes thugs rje yis/ /dus gsum mi 'gyur chos skur bde klong 'khyil/ /de las phyir gsal longs sprul snang ba yis/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis sgrub la nor bu bzhin/ /gnyis ka mi rtog 'od gsal chen po ste/ /ji ltar snang yang de ltar ma grub pas/ gdod ma'i gzhi la 'pho 'gyur med par gnas/ /nang bzhugs dus na sku gsum gzhir bzhag ste/ /phyir gsal sku gsum gzhi bzhengs chen po yis/ / dbyings las ma g.yos 'gro don rgyun mi chad/ /'dir dag kun kyang ra ི ga pa'i yon tan te/ /rang gzhan don gnyis ma lus phun tshogs shing*/ /ji snyed ji bzhin gzigs pa rnam dag pas/ /kun mkhyen ye shes mdzod brnyes lha yi lha/ /gdod ma'i mgon por lhun gyis grub pa yin/ /de ltar dbyings rig ye shes 'bras bu'i don/ /pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis bstan nas song*/ /gsang spyod rdo rje lam bstan las/ 'bras bu rdo rje'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// // 'dir ni snying po'i mthar thug zab mo'i lam/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig tshe gcig sangs rgyas lam/ /bcud kyi snying po yang nas yang bsdus pa/ /rdo rje snying po'i tha ེ ga mchog gsal bar byas/ /dge ba 'di yis ma lus 'gro ba kun/ /theg mchog 'dir zhugs 'od gsal mthar phyin te/

/sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa yis/ /lhun grub sa la kun tu bzang por shog /bdag blo'i mkha' la rtogs pa'i nyi shar bas/ /skal ldan blo yi pad+mo kha 'byed slad/ /gsang spyod snying po rdo rje lam bstan 'di/ /gangs ri thod dkar mgul du legs par bkod/ /gang gis mi snyogs thar pa'i grong khyer na/ / 'di yis legs bgrod zab mo'i gnad bstan pas/ /bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa'i ra ba yongs spangs te/ /'gro kun dga' ba'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin par shog /gsang spyod rdo rje lam bstan zhes bya ba/ /dpal o rgyan gyi mkhas pa chen po/ rang byung pad+ma rgyal po'i thugs kyi 'od zer blo'i khang bzangs su shar bas snang bar byas pa 'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis ston gsum gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul/ o rgyan rdzong gi gnas mchog dam par/ rin chen shog skya'i ngos la legs par bkod pa rdzogs so// //dge zhing bkra shis/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (8)gsang spyod rdo rje lam bstan/ - PAGE 2 -- PAGE 15 -- PAGE 1 -
